children: Ventas reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.83 billion and Normalized FFO of $0.99 per share, up 10% year over year. Net income attributable to common stockholders was $65.4 million, or $0.13 per share. The company raised its full-year Normalized FFO guidance to $3.87–$3.90 per share.
Revenue was $1.832 billion, compared with $1.489 billion in the third quarter of 2025.
Net income attributable to common stockholders was $65.4 million, versus $66.0 million a year earlier; attributable net income was $0.13 per share, compared with $0.14.
Nareit FFO was $1.01 per share, up 15% year over year; Normalized FFO was $0.99 per share, up 10%.
Ventas raised its 2026 Normalized FFO guidance to $3.87–$3.90 per share, from $3.85–$3.90. Its Nareit FFO guidance is now $3.83–$3.86 per share.
SHOP same-store Cash NOI increased 16% year over year. Same-store revenue per occupied room rose 5%, while average occupancy improved 290 basis points.
U.S. SHOP same-store Cash NOI grew 17%, with average occupancy up 320 basis points to above 90%.
Ventas closed $1.2 billion of senior housing investments during the quarter and $5.2 billion year to date; the company reported an active pipeline of additional SHOP opportunities.
The company reported total portfolio NOI growth of 18% year over year and same-store Cash NOI growth of 11%.

title: Ventas Posts 10% Normalized FFO Growth and Raises 2026 Guidance
